name: Adhithyan Sudhaghar
text:
Dubai Parks and Dubai Municipality parks truly set the benchmark for family-friendly spaces in the city. Unfortunately, this park was the complete opposite.

It’s small, overcrowded, and poorly managed. What was most frustrating was the behavior of the security guard, who acted as though he personally owned the place. After 9 PM, he arbitrarily blocked access to the park’s parking area with cones, despite there being absolutely no official signs, rules, or notices stating parking is prohibited after that time. Even worse, we watched him allow other cars in after 9:10 PM, and only after confronting him about this obvious inconsistency, pointing out he had literally allowed someone in two minutes earlier were we able to enter.

To make matters worse, with well over 100 people still inside the park, the staff switched off all the lights exactly at 10 PM without any warning, announcement, whistle, or basic courtesy. Imagine being seated on the far side of the park while your toddlers are still in the play area suddenly plunged into darkness, scrambling to find your children, their toys, and your belongings. It was chaotic, unsafe, and completely unacceptable.

This is not the standard anyone expects from public parks in Dubai. Poor management, inconsistent enforcement, and zero consideration for families made this a terrible experience. I’ve never encountered such careless and disrespectful treatment at any other park in Dubai, and I will absolutely never return.
